candidates.description: Baseline functional status of the patient based on the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group scale.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value associated with 'ECOG performance status' or 'ECOG status'.
candidates.measurement_definition: A score from 0 (fully active) to 2 (ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities) as documented in clinical assessments.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The exact timing of the assessment (whether it represents the absolute baseline prior to any therapy or a stable state during surveillance) varies across notes.

candidates.description: Estimated renal function used to determine chemotherapy dose suitability.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value and units (mL/min) associated with 'Calculated CrCl' or 'Calculated Creatinine Clearance'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) measured in mL/min, typically using the Cockcroft-Gault formula.
candidates.name: Creatinine Clearance
candidates.uncertainty: Some patients have eGFR reported instead of CrCl, which may not be directly interchangeable depending on the formula used.

limitations: Creatinine clearance is not documented for every patient in the provided evidence.
The sample size of patients is very small, limiting the range of values observed for performance status and renal function.
summary: The evidence supports the use of baseline functional status (ECOG performance status) and renal function (Creatinine Clearance) as measurable clinical variables in this cohort of NSCLC patients.
